content: Řɣedran n Ṣidqiya
Yusa-dd ɣari wawař n SIDI, inna:
“A mmis n bnadem, ɛawed ict n ṭḥajit n twafit u ewc ijj n umedya i taddart n Israil
uca ini:
‘Ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI! Agider d ameqqran s wafriwen arezmen, daysen řewtad iziraren ccuren s warric d tintat ifarzen, yusa-dd ɣar idurar n Lubnan uca ikkes tuccent n tcejjart n tengelt.
Azeǧif n řefruɛ nnes issendayen ikkes i-t, uca yiwyi t ɣar ict n temmurt n ttijara uca issars i-t deg ict n tendint n isebbaben.
Iksi zi zzariɛet n temmurt uca igga i-tt deg ijj n yeyyar icna i wezraɛ. Iksi tt, iẓẓu tt am tcejjart n uṣefṣaf ɣar waman aṭṭas.

Teɣmi-dd zzariɛet uca tedweř d tazayart s řefruɛ wessɛen ak-d trunku d aquḍaḍ nni zi dewřent tseḍwin ɣar ugider, am tuɣa iẓewran nnes qqimen sadu nnes. Ammu i tedweř d ict n tzayart nni issuffɣen tiseḍwin uca tegga ad ssendyen ifetwan.

Tuɣa ɛawed ijj n ugider ameqqran nneɣni s wafriwen imɣaren d waṭṭas n arric uca xzar, tazayart tarra iẓewran nnes ɣares uca tesswiẓẓeḍ tiseḍwin nnes ɣares zeg iyyar mani tᵉttwaẓẓu ḥima agider ad as issessu.
Tuɣa tᵉttwaẓẓu deg ijj n yeyyar isbeḥ zzat i waman aṭṭas ḥima ad tessuffeɣ tiseḍwin uca ad tewc řɣiǧet, ḥima ad tedweř d tazayart teccur.’

Ini xenni: ‘Ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI: Ma ad iffeɣ man aya mliḥ? Ma war ittekkes ugider ameqqran iẓewran nnes uca ad iqḍeɛ řɣiǧet nnes ařami i ɣa taẓeɣ? Wah ad taẓeɣ s marra tifray nni ɣares iɣemmyen, war ittwaḥdij ɛad uɣiř ijehden niɣ řɣaci aṭṭas ḥima ad tt ssgeɛɛden zeg iẓewran nnes.
Xzar, waxxa ẓẓun tt, maca ma xenni ad tefřeḥ? Ma war tᵉttiẓeɣ xmi tt ɣa iřqef usemmiḍ n řɣarb? Wah, ad taẓeɣ x iɛurar n řeɛraṣi mani dd-tɣemmi.’”
Yusa-dd ɣari wawař n SIDI, inna:
“Ini řexxu i taddart iɣewwɣen: ‘Ma war tessinem min ɛnant tmesřayin-a?’ Ini: ‘Xzar, ajeǧid n Babil yusa-dd ɣar Urcalim uca iṭṭef ajeǧid nnes d řḥukkam nnes uca yiwyi ten ɣares di Babil.
Iṭṭef ɛawed ijjen zi zzariɛet igellden uca igga akides ijj n řɛahd uca yarra i-t ad iwc tajaǧit u ayt n jjehd di temmurt, aqa ikkes i-ten,
ḥima ad tiři tgeldit twaḍeɛ u war tessgiɛɛid ixef nnes u ḥima ad teḥḍa řɛahd nnes, ad teqqim tᵉttbedda.

Maca netta iɣewweɣ xas, issekk ireqqasen nnes ɣar Miṣra, maḥend ad as wcen iysan d ijj n ubarru n řgens. Ma ad iffeɣ aya mliḥ? Ma izemmar ad yarweř wenni iggin aya? Ma izemmar wenni yarẓin řɛahd ad yarweř?’”

“S tidett am ddareɣ Necc, iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI: ‘Deg wemcan mani izeddeɣ ujeǧid nni t iggin d ajeǧid, wenni zi isseḥqar netta tajaǧit i d as ijjuǧ, d wenni zi yarẓ řɛahd i kides igga, aqa din ɣares, di řwest n Babil, ad immet!

War izemmar firɛun s ijj n řɛeskar ameqqran d ijj n wegraw imɣar ad yegg uřa d ict n řḥajjet di ṭṭweɛ nnes deg umenɣi, xmi ɣa ssgeɛɛden ijj n řḥiḍ uca xmi ɣa bnan ijj n wecbar maḥend ad nɣen aṭṭas n iwdan.
Aqa isseḥqar tajaǧit umi yarẓa řɛahd i x iwca afus nnes. Minzi netta igga marra man aya, war ittrakkwař.’”
“S uya, ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI: ‘S tidett am ddareɣ Necc, tajaǧit i d ayi ijjuǧ uca xenni isseḥqar i-tt, uřa d řɛahd i kidi igga uca xenni yarẓa i-t, ad ten-i-dd arreɣ x uzeǧif nnes!
Ad xas bezzɛeɣ tracca inu maḥend ad yiři icarf di řfex inu. Ad t awyeɣ ɣar Babil uca ad xas carrɛeɣ din zi ssibbet n řeɣdaret nnes i zi d ayi iɣdar.
Marra inni zzayes yarewřen jmiɛ ak-d marra řɛeskar nnes, ad wḍan s ssif, uca inni iqqimen ad ttwazeǧɛen ɣar marra tiɣemmura n usemmiḍ. Xenni kenniw ad tessnem belli Necc, SIDI, ssiwřeɣ.’”

“Ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI: ‘Necc ad kkseɣ ijj n ufetwi n tuccent n tcejjart n tengelt yuɛřan uca ad t ẓẓuɣ. Zeg uzeǧif ak-d tseḍwin nnes ad qeřɛeɣ ict n tseṭṭa tarhef uca ad tt ẓẓuɣ x ijj n wedrar yuɛřan.

Ad tt ẓẓuɣ x wedrar yuɛřan qaɛ di Israil. Tanita ad tawi tiseḍwin uca ad tarr řɣiǧet, ad tedweř d tacejjart n tengelt ijehden. Ɛřam kuř ijḍaḍ s ɛřam kuř afriwen ad zedɣen sadu nnes, wah, di tiři nnes ad zedɣen nitni,

uca ad ssnen marra ticejjura n yeyyar, aqa Necc, SIDI, ssehwiɣ tacejjart yuɛřan uca ssgeɛɛdeɣ tacejjart taquḍaḍt u ssiẓɣeɣ tacejjart tazeyzat uca arriɣ tacejjart yuẓɣen ad tnewwar. Necc, SIDI, ssiwřeɣ uca ad t ggeɣ.’”
